rec0QPYzm6s8Y3CTq.Bio: Dylan Saccoccio is the author of the Spirit Whirled series, The Real Universal Empire, and the Tale of Onora. After chasing language back as far as possible, he now explores other avenues to prove cultural diffusion of the ancient universal empire of priests, navigators, masons, and merchants. Find his latest of many hundreds of articles on Substack.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Dylan Saccoccio returns to put the heliocentric model to the fire and test its veracity. In this paradigm shattering chat we examine a few Black Swan observations which, we argue, negate the cosmological theories proposed by NASA and other authority outlets.
fields.Title: Dylan Saccoccio | Black Swans VS the Ball Model & Heliohexes
